requirements.text: The requirement is contemplated as a total small business set-aside under NAICS 541512 with a size standard of $34 million.
requirements.quote: total small business set-aside under NAICS 541512 with a size standard of $34 million

requirements.text: Respondents must have an active SAM.gov registration at the time of response.
requirements.quote: Respondents must be registered and active in SAM.gov at the time of response.

requirements.text: Respondents must hold an active FedRAMP Moderate authorization, or partner with a FedRAMP Moderate authorized cloud service provider.
requirements.quote: Respondents must hold an active FedRAMP Moderate authorization or be a partner of a FedRAMP Moderate authorized cloud service provider.

requirements.text: Migrate approximately 400 on-premises workloads from the Kansas City and Ogden data centers to a FedRAMP Moderate cloud environment within 24 months of award.
requirements.quote: The contractor shall migrate approximately 400 on-premises workloads from the Kansas City and Ogden data centers

requirements.text: Provide 24x7 managed operations including monitoring, patching and incident response for all migrated workloads.
requirements.quote: shall provide 24x7 managed operations including monitoring, patching and incident response

requirements.text: Develop a migration wave plan within 45 calendar days of award.
requirements.quote: shall develop a migration wave plan within 45 calendar days of award

requirements.text: Maintain a Recovery Time Objective of four hours and a Recovery Point Objective of one hour for Tier 1 applications.
requirements.quote: Recovery Time Objective of four hours and a Recovery Point Objective of one hour for Tier 1 applications

requirements.text: Ensure all personnel with access to Federal Tax Information complete IRS Publication 1075 background investigations before access is granted.
requirements.quote: all personnel with access to Federal Tax Information complete IRS Publication 1075 background investigations

requirements.text: Provide a transition-out plan 90 days before the end of the contract.
requirements.quote: shall provide a transition-out plan 90 days before the end of the contract

requirements.text: Responses may not exceed 10 pages, excluding the cover page.
requirements.quote: Responses shall not exceed 10 pages, excluding the cover page.

requirements.text: Use 12-point Times New Roman font with one-inch margins on letter-size paper.
requirements.quote: 12-point Times New Roman font with one-inch margins on letter-size paper

requirements.text: Submit the capability statement as a single PDF file.
requirements.quote: Submit the capability statement as a single PDF file.

requirements.text: File names must follow the pattern CompanyName_IRS_SS_0042.pdf.
requirements.quote: File names shall follow the pattern CompanyName_IRS_SS_0042.pdf.

requirements.text: Include the company name, UEI, CAGE code, business size and socio-economic status on the cover page.
requirements.quote: company name, UEI, CAGE code, business size and socio-economic status on the cover page

requirements.text: Email responses to the Contracting Officer at market.research@irs.example.gov no later than 2:00 PM Eastern Time on October 30, 2026.
requirements.quote: emailed to the Contracting Officer at market.research@irs.example.gov no later than 2:00 PM Eastern Time on October 30, 2026

requirements.text: The email subject line must read 'Sources Sought 2032H5-26-SS-0042 - Company Name'.
requirements.quote: The email subject line must read 'Sources Sought 2032H5-26-SS-0042 - Company Name'.

requirements.text: Submit questions in writing by October 16, 2026; telephone inquiries will not be accepted.
requirements.quote: Questions must be submitted in writing by October 16, 2026; telephone inquiries will not be accepted.

requirements.text: Responses are reviewed for demonstrated experience migrating at least 200 workloads for a federal agency within the past three years.
requirements.quote: demonstrated experience migrating at least 200 workloads for a federal agency within the past three years

requirements.text: The Government will assess the relevance of past performance in FedRAMP Moderate environments handling Federal Tax Information.
requirements.quote: assess the relevance of past performance in FedRAMP Moderate environments handling Federal Tax Information

requirements.text: The Government will consider the respondent's ability to provide cleared staff in Kansas City, Missouri and Ogden, Utah.
requirements.quote: ability to provide cleared staff in Kansas City, Missouri and Ogden, Utah

requirements.text: Capability statements should identify teaming or subcontracting arrangements and the percentage of work performed by the small business prime.
requirements.quote: identify any teaming or subcontracting arrangements and the percentage of work to be performed by the small business prime

requirements.text: All information is to be provided at no cost to the Government.
requirements.quote: All information is to be provided at no cost.

requirements.text: Provide 24x7 managed operations, including monitoring, patching and incident response, for all migrated workloads.
requirements.quote: 24x7 managed operations including monitoring, patching and incident response

requirements.text: The contractor shall staff a program management office in Washington, DC.
requirements.quote: program management office in Washington, DC

requirements.text: The contractor shall provide onsite staff at all IRS facilities nationwide.
requirements.quote: the contractor shall provide onsite staff at all IRS facilities nationwide
